name: session-board
description: Strip above the prompt: other sessions that need you or are done; this session's task bar, subagent models and files while it works, and a ◈ chip that counts its background jobs, agents, monitors and wake-ups apart; a recap when Claude flags a check or assumptions wait. /sessions has Sessions, Turns, Files and Context tabs. Context guard: from 200K an Actions menu (the context size itself is in the usage gauge's context meter) and, from 300K, advice, with picks that TYPE into the prompt box and never run anything: Compact… (a picker of what to keep), Plain compact (/compact) and Clear (/clear). You read the command, change it if you like, and press Enter. A /compact you press Enter on is never changed; the engine's own late compaction is told to keep paths, ids and rules. Each turn end from 200K adds one line (context, grade, whether the buttons were on offer, the saving) to ~/.claude/session-board/guard/, apart from the journal's log folder. The Context tab shows today's count from it. Facts from events and git status; Claude's one-line turn summary is the only token cost, and a compaction costs what any compaction costs.

journal.title: Journal log
journal.description: Keep a daily log of Claude's turns for a journal wrap-up to read, and show a 📓 button on turn cards. Needs a journal skill that reads ~/.claude/session-board/log.

mode.title: Context guard mode
mode.description: advise: show the chip and the buttons that type the command. The mod never compacts or clears by itself. off: nothing. The mode you pick in the Context tab of /sessions wins over this setting.

adviseAtK.title: Advise from (thousand tokens)
adviseAtK.description: The chip offers to compact from here. It also needs the context to be 150K above its size after the last compaction.
